title: Customer churn prediction for a telecom operator
problem: monthly churn was 3.1% and the retention team called customers at random
approach: built a gradient-boosted classifier on 14 months of usage and billing data, calibrated the probabilities and ranked accounts by risk
results: recall on churners rose from 0.41 to 0.68 at the same precision
the retention team now targets about 3,200 at-risk accounts a month

title: Retrieval-augmented support assistant
problem: support agents answered the same tier-1 questions from a 900-page knowledge base
approach: chunked the docs by heading, added hybrid retrieval and citation checking, and exposed it as an API used by the help widget
results: deflected 31% of tier-1 tickets in the first two months
answer groundedness of 0.92 on a 200-question evaluation set

title: Invoice field extraction pipeline
problem: an accounts-payable team keyed 1,500 invoices a week by hand
approach: fine-tuned a layout-aware extraction model and wrapped it in a pipeline that routes low-confidence fields to a human
results: processing time fell from about 6 minutes to 40 seconds per invoice
field-level F1 of 0.94 on unseen suppliers

title: Demand forecasting for a grocery chain
problem: store managers over-ordered fresh produce and threw away margin
approach: trained a global gradient-boosting model with holiday and weather features and produced daily forecasts per store and SKU
results: MAPE improved from 24% to 13%
fresh-produce waste fell 9% across 14 stores

title: Visual defect detection on a production line
problem: manual inspection missed hairline scratches on aluminium panels
approach: labelled 6,000 images, trained a YOLO detector and tuned it for the line's lighting
results: detected 96% of scratches at 30 frames per second
false rejects stayed under 1.5%

title: Product recommendations for an online store
problem: the store showed the same best-sellers to every visitor
approach: trained a two-tower model on clicks and purchases and served candidates with a re-ranking step
results: click-through on recommendations rose 18% over four weeks
average order value up 4%

title: Contract clause extraction
problem: lawyers spent hours locating indemnity and termination clauses
approach: built a clause classifier and entity extractor and a review screen that highlights each clause
results: clause extraction F1 of 0.89
first-pass review time down 55%

title: Sales-research agent built with LangGraph
problem: account executives spent 25 minutes researching each prospect
approach: designed a multi-step agent that searches approved sources, drafts a brief and asks a human to approve CRM updates
results: research brief ready in about 90 seconds instead of 25 minutes
no CRM write happens without approval

title: Real-time transaction fraud scoring
problem: rule-based fraud checks blocked good customers and missed new attack patterns
approach: engineered velocity and device features and served the model behind a low-latency API
results: p99 scoring latency of 38 ms
caught 22% more fraud at the same false-positive rate

title: Review sentiment analytics
problem: a hotel group could not see why ratings were slipping
approach: classified reviews by aspect and sentiment and built an interactive dashboard for managers
results: classified 120,000 reviews across 40 hotels
surfaced 5 recurring complaint themes

title: Automated model retraining pipeline
problem: retraining a pricing model took two days of manual work
approach: automated data checks, training, evaluation gates and staged rollout
results: retraining went from two days of manual work to a 40-minute pipeline
every model version is reproducible

title: Call transcription and summarisation
problem: clinic staff wrote call notes by hand after each patient call
approach: transcribed calls, removed identifiers and generated structured summaries for staff to approve
results: summaries for about 1,800 calls a day
word error rate of 7.9% on accented speech

title: Dynamic pricing model for a travel site
problem: prices for add-ons were set once a year
approach: modelled demand elasticity per route and season and searched price points within business limits
results: revenue per booking up 6.5%
no loss in conversion during the test

title: Semantic search for a research library
problem: keyword search failed on synonyms and paraphrased questions
approach: embedded 300,000 abstracts, added a re-ranker and built an evaluation set with librarians
results: nDCG@10 improved from 0.51 to 0.74
median query time 120 ms

title: Support ticket routing classifier
problem: tickets bounced between teams before reaching the right one
approach: fine-tuned a compact transformer on 80,000 historical tickets and distilled it for cheap inference
results: routing accuracy of 91%
inference cost down 70% after distillation

title: Sensor anomaly detection for pumping stations
problem: pump failures were only noticed after a station went offline
approach: combined seasonal decomposition with isolation forests on vibration and pressure signals
results: flagged pump failures 36 hours earlier on average
alert volume kept under 5 a day

title: LLM evaluation harness
problem: prompt changes shipped without anyone knowing whether quality dropped
approach: built golden datasets, an LLM judge calibrated against human labels, and regression thresholds
results: caught 3 quality regressions before release
judge-human agreement of kappa 0.71

title: Medical image classification prototype
problem: a research team needed a baseline for chest X-ray triage
approach: fine-tuned an ImageNet backbone with heavy augmentation and site-wise validation
results: AUC of 0.88 on a held-out hospital
results written up for an internal review
